materials.name: gear
materials.look: WARM TAN, like khaki canvas and tan webbing
materials.wears: the belt itself, a broad flat band of stiff tan webbing as wide as a hand is across three fingers, and every pouch on it: two tall magazine pouches side by side on the wearer's left hip, each a plain box with a flap lid, and one wider, flatter utility pouch at the middle of the back. Each pouch is a simple chunky box sewn flat against the outside of the band.

materials.name: shell
materials.look: BRIGHT LIGHT SKY BLUE hard plastic, a saturated baby blue (hex #78AAE6), clearly coloured and as light as the tan
materials.wears: exactly two hard things: the big rectangular buckle at the middle of the front, one solid plate two fingers wider than the band, and the pistol holster on the wearer's right hip, one solid moulded shell shaped like a closed pistol pouch, as long as a hand, that hangs straight down from the band with its top edge level with the band's top. The holster is closed and empty-looking: one smooth shell with no pistol grip sticking out.

prompt:
Product image of one police-style duty belt for a near-future corporate security guard, shown by itself: a belt buckled closed into a ring, floating in the air with nobody wearing it. Nothing else is in the image: no body, no mannequin, no trousers, no stand.

Shape, the most important thing in this image: the belt is a closed, level, oval hoop, as if buckled round an invisible person's waist, wider from side to side than from front to back. The hoop is empty: through it the plain white background shows, and the inner face of the far side of the band is visible above the near side. The band is the same height all the way round and keeps level, like a ring lying flat.

{materials}
The blue buckle and the blue holster are clearly bluer than the tan band and pouches. Every part of the belt is one of these two colours.

Everything on the belt is attached flat to the outside of the band and stays close to it. Nothing hangs loose, nothing dangles on straps or chains, and the inside of the hoop is smooth and empty. In the image the buckle is at the centre front, the holster is on the left edge of the image, and the two magazine pouches are on the right edge of the image.

Smooth clean surfaces like a painted sculpt: plain colour on every part, clean and new, matte plastic and smooth webbing, simple chunky shapes, clean edges between parts.

Camera: front view from a little above, looking down at the belt by about 25 degrees, long lens with almost no perspective. The hoop is centred and symmetrical left to right.

Soft even studio lighting with gentle shading that shows the forms, the whole belt in frame with margin on all sides, plain white background.
